retrieval_skill.name: trend_continuation_check
retrieval_skill.description: Retrieve evidence about whether an observed local trend is likely to continue, reverse, or settle at a boundary within the forecast horizon, rather than assuming the latest level persists.
retrieval_skill.applicability: When forecasting a short time series with a clear recent directional movement and a plausible boundary or terminal state.
retrieval_skill.query_strategy: Search for contemporaneous, process-specific evidence describing the direction, persistence, stopping behavior, and likely boundary state during the relevant temporal window; prioritize sources that explain the latent mechanism driving the series.
retrieval_skill.verification_rule: Accept a trend-continuation claim only when the evidence is temporally aligned with the forecast window, directly supports the stated direction or boundary behavior, and preserves exact-quote and provenance requirements; otherwise retain the persistence baseline.
